statement: Keep laboratory glassware clean, treating laboratory equipment as falling within the scope of the equipment cleaning and maintenance requirements.
quote: Glassware must, of course, be clean, and CGMP regulations consider laboratory equipment to be included within the scope of 21 CFR 211.67.
